name: Ashes of revolution
source:
A series of disappearance cases occur in Doxka suburb in Kavkazstan federation

Ali tries to solve the mystery of this disappearances only to led him to discover secrets of militias and remnants of regime


the game features:

    three languages (chapter 2 translations in arabic and spanish are being worked on )
    55 minutes of gameplay

the game is not finished yet and there will be more chapters in the future 

content warning, this game contains:

    semi-saturated colors
    self-harm and sui...cide
    war and revolutions
    traumas
    death of young people


Credits for people who helped me in this game:

- Rune-2-12 for some sprite art

- ElQuetzalcoutl for drawing a CG scene
translation:
高加索斯坦联邦的多克斯卡郊区接连发生了一连串人口失踪案。

阿里试图解开这些失踪事件背后的谜团，却在追查途中意外揭开了民兵武装与旧政权残余势力暗藏的秘密。

游戏特色：
•支持三种语言（第二章的阿拉伯语与西班牙语译文正在制作中）
•约55分钟的游玩流程

本作尚未完结，未来还将更新更多章节。

内容警告，本作包含以下要素：
•中等饱和度色彩画面
•自残与自杀
•战争与革命
•心理创伤
•青年死亡

协助制作鸣谢：
•Rune-2-12：绘制部分角色立绘
•ElQuetzalcoutl：绘制一幅CG场景
